zh-CN: 基于已发布的 1.2.15 调整 AI 命令键，保留 Air75 V3 连接动画。
默认 F7 普通／极速模式、F8 批准、F9 拒绝、F10 新聊天、F11 听写、F12 发送。
Codex 专用命令自动准备并保留用户原有快捷键；批准、拒绝和发送仅由实体命令键触发。
en: Update AI command keys on the released 1.2.15 foundation while preserving the Air75 V3 connection animation.
Default F7 Standard/Fast, F8 approve, F9 decline, F10 new chat, F11 dictation and F12 send.
Prepare dedicated Codex commands while preserving existing shortcuts; approval, decline and send require a physical key press.
